Flock.squeeze_answers (kind : UInt8) (n : Nat) (t t' : Flock.Transcript) (coins : Array Flock.F128) (hn : n ≠ 0)
(h : Flock.Transcript.squeeze kind n t = Except.ok (coins, t')) :
t.rounds[t.k]? = some r ∧
r.n = n ∧
r.answers (t.framed kind n) ∧
coins = r.coins ∧ t' = { rounds := t.rounds, k := t.k + 1, pending := ByteArray.empty }
Flock.squeeze_retained (kind : UInt8) (n : Nat) (t t' : Flock.Transcript) (coins : Array Flock.F128) (hn : n ≠ 0)
